title: Lab 5: Count Regression
text:
Code
library(tidyverse) # Includes dplyr, ggplot2, and forcats
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggeffects)
library(emmeans)
library(broom.mixed)
library(gt)
library(AER)







Code
# Load NMES1988 explicitly from AER before creating the analysis dataset.
data("NMES1988", package = "AER")
data <- NMES1988

# Rebuild the factors to clear any contrasts stored in the original dataset.
data <- data |>
  select(visits, chronic, health, gender, school, insurance) |>
  mutate(
    health = fct_relevel(factor(health), "average"),
    gender = fct_relevel(factor(gender), "male"),
    insurance = fct_relevel(factor(insurance), "no")
  )


The NMES1988 dataset contains 4,406 respondents from the US National Medical Expenditure Survey. The outcome is the number of physician office visits. The predictors are number of chronic conditions, self-perceived health, gender, years of education, and private insurance coverage.
The reference groups are average for health, male for gender, and no for private insurance.





Code
# Summarize physician office visits.
visits_summary <- data |>
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = mean(visits),
    var    = var(visits),
    p_zero = mean(visits == 0),
    max    = max(visits)
  )




Code
visits_table <- visits_summary |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Descriptive statistics for physician office visits") |>
  cols_label(
    n = "N",
    mean = "Mean",
    var = "Variance",
    p_zero = "Proportion with zero visits",
    max = "Maximum"
  ) |>
  fmt_integer(columns = c(n, max)) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean, var), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = p_zero, decimals = 2)




Code
visits_table

Code
descriptive_plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = visits)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Physician office visits", y = "Number of participants")




Code
descriptive_plot








Figure 1: Distribution of physician office visits.
